// webpack/runtime/hot_module_replacement_chunk_groups
(() => {
var chunkGroups = {"async_js":["shared"],"other_js":["shared"]};
__webpack_require__.f.group = function (chunkId, promises, fetchPriority) {
	var siblings = chunkGroups[chunkId];
	if (!siblings) return;
	var keys = Object.keys(__webpack_require__.f).filter(function (key) { return key !== "group"; });
	siblings.forEach(function (id) {
		keys.forEach(function (key) { __webpack_require__.f[key](id, promises, fetchPriority); });
	});
};

})();

}
;
